## Summary
Supply chain verification is the process of confirming the integrity and compliance of various components that comprise a product’s journey from production to consumer. In an increasingly globalized economy, the significance of this process cannot be overstated. It ensures that products meet required standards, reduce the risk of fraud, and enhance consumer trust. For instance, when a consumer purchases ethically sourced coffee, they want to be assured that the beans were cultivated sustainably
